integrity.supplementary_recomputation: Standalone Python script verifies 387 finite assertions; it does not establish the asymptotic theorem.

scientific_limitations: The joint convergence applies to fixed face dimensions only; no moving-rank limit is asserted.
The proof invokes the standard empirical CDF stochastic equicontinuity lemma and multivariate CLT.
The exact finite moments refer to the normalized shadow volume; no general mixed-moment formula is asserted.
Historical priority is provisional and no independent mathematical validation is claimed.
title: Asymptotically independent shadow-volume and central-section face fluctuations of a regular simplex
